budget.charged: All construction, initial/final evaluation, training, actual attempted phases/transports and refusals in this new stage. Earlier charges are reported cumulatively, not subtracted from this deadline. Boundaries are checked between rounds/panels; retain bounded final-panel overrun.
budget.stop: One frozen founder numerical-policy control only. Capped, refused and unrun cells cannot establish admission; no cap, dt or force grid and no fresh confirmation seeds.

protocol.candidate_selection: After all four capacity cells pass, one separate agreement-only relevance round across all five H1/H2/resource arms and founders0/1; all ten cells remain. No linear fallback, initializer, parameter grid or confirmation.

capacity_stage.gate: Unchanged .95 on complete48 trained cases for exact pair, each slot, unequal pairs and each query,512 rounds and no action/lesson refusal. Final intact train/held_out/all panels must be fully answered without refusal or budget truncation; the16 held-out cases have no accuracy floor and are reported separately. Optional erased-panel accuracy is not an acquisition gate.
capacity_stage.guard: Both exposed founders must pass before the supplied-read pair runs. An exposed failure stops admission before oracle work; missing/unrun oracle cells can never produce a positive capacity result. All four cells must pass before any relevance work.

protocol.confirmation_status: unopened; requires all development gates and a separately declared total budget

causal_controls: head permutation with downstream transport custody explicit
gates.content_use: Held-address agreement oracle on H2 anatomy, both actual namedfacts, totalcoupling3 and same restoring law; finalpair/slot/unequal/query95 training48 bothfounders, held16reported. No learned-head assignment claim.
gates.exposed_panel: All 48 training cases: exact pair, each slot, unequal-value pairs and each query; both development founders. The 16 held-out cases are reported separately.
gates.promotion: All development gates must pass on both founders 0 and 1 before confirmation; retain failures, refusals and caps. No library or default promotion from this experiment.
gates.retention: Continue balanced training on the same 12 pairs, then read the held-out panel; retain .95 on the training panel. No competing-task or P7 claim.

protocol.heads: Shared bank; disjoint live query/read ports; same complete query initial drive; query-cortex projections zero initially, ordinary reciprocal read-cortex seams independently drawn. Total coupling3 shared equally over independent heads; no supplied head-to-name assignment.

numerical_control.default_guard: Fresh plain Brain.compose without an explicit neuron-model or dt override must report dt1.0. learning_neuron_model helper default0.5 and bare NeuronModel default0.2 are not the composed founder.
numerical_control.equations: Same continuous field, fixed witnessed bank and learned parameters. Numerical dt-only clones preserve the actual graph/memory, and all free/nudged states are tested against the complete original equations.
numerical_control.initializer: The separately frozen finite memory-start initializer failed both saved boundaries; it is not implemented or used.
numerical_control.reason: Saved failed-boundary Jacobians are locally unstable for Euler dt1.0, while dt0.5 is locally stable at those sampled points; use the existing bounded halving policy with exact immutable memory preserved. Some earlier accepted states have a positive continuous mode or a kink; no uniform contraction or global convergence claim. Full original-field qualification remains mandatory.

protocol.preservation: Retain previous failed admission/coupled-reader receipts and existing gates. Reward custody, private imagination, complete checkpoint continuation, continuing context/recovery and learned semantic codes remain separate requirements before integration.
protocol.primary_boundary: Clear working trace and warm neural state after prefix before query in training/evaluation, keep only witnessed memory bank. Live query/read/association/motor coordinates all qualify jointly. Intact-trace comparison is later and separate.

prior.custody: Require the retained failed receipt via --prior; verify digest, arithmetic and original archived source bytes with the repository verifier. Historical sources need not equal the new numerical-policy sources.

relevance_stage.required: All four current-source capacity cells pass unchanged .95 trained floors and complete512 rounds without refusals before any of the ten agreement-only relevance cells. Preserve cumulative prior and capacity charges; this new600-second stage has an independent deadline. No confirmation or default promotion.

representation_phase.variable: Free settled association activation, not context-free held LearnedCode output

protocol.scope: Founder numerical-policy control on the unchanged raw dual-binding component: actual Brain.compose dt=1.0 with existing bounded halving damping=3, complete original-field qualification, no new learning rule or initializer. Capacity first; no learned-selection, head-advantage, semantic or continuing-life claim from acquisition.

source.freeze: Commit this protocol and every executed source before the one capacity stage; retain all earlier failed sources and receipts. Later relevance requires this exact positive capacity source manifest.

task.evaluation: Enumerate all training and held-out cases once; exact pair, each slot, unequal pairs and each query reported; refused/unrun answers count wrong
task.facts: IS + name + value; two actual fact events, both orders balanced, then one neutral event
task.query: AMBIGUOUS_CUE + ASK_AB or ASK_BA; no values or intermediate address
task.schedule: SeedSequence([622022, founder]); each round samples 16 training cases with replacement; every arm uses identical draws
task.swapped_panel: Exchange values attached to A/B with query, fact order and token multiset fixed; held-out swaps stay held out; equal-value swaps are shams
task.training_pairs: All remaining 12 ordered pairs; all equal pairs and every value under each name remain in training

protocol.teaching: Capture complete pre-query drive and immutable bank before greedy act; wrong-pair rows only, both final labels supplied; no head role, slot index, address, intermediate value or relevance mask taught. Corresponding rows of captured drive and bank remain together through free/nudged phases.
